title: MoHoBench: Assessing Honesty of Multimodal Large Language Models via Unanswerable Visual Questions
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure anything specific to religion or faith. Its 'Subjective or Philosophical' category assesses a model's ability to handle questions requiring subjective opinions, ethical judgments, or philosophical reasoning, but the examples provided relate to general existentialism or subjective interpretation rather than specific religious themes.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
